stem.text: The presence of a halogen in an organic compound may be detected by warming the organic compound with aqueous silver nitrate.
Which compound would be the quickest to produce a precipitate?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched chain with Cl at the left end, Cl on the top branch and Cl on the bottom branch

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched chain with Cl at the left end, F on the top branch and F on the bottom branch

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched chain with F at the left end, F on the top branch and I on the bottom branch

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched chain with Br at the left end, Cl on the top branch and F on the bottom branch
